recall_prompt: Say how you would find r when 15 C 2r minus 1 equals 15 C 2r plus 4.
insider_note: A false equal branch is part of the design: 2r − 1 = 2r + 4 gives −1 = 4, so the sum branch is the only route — and the lower numbers add to the upper 15, never to each other: (2r − 1) + (2r + 4) = 15, so r = 3.

steps.label: Use ⁿCᵣ = ⁿCₛ ⇒ r = s or r + s = n
steps.margin_note: First mark. The two lower numbers 2r − 1 and 2r + 4 can never be equal (they differ by 5), so they must add to 15.
steps.memory_tip: The two lower numbers differ by 5, so they can never be equal — only the sum branch is left.
lines: ⁿCᵣ = ⁿCₛ ⇒ r = s or r + s = n

recall.must_convey: That the identity gives two cases, the equal case is impossible because 2r minus 1 can never equal 2r plus 4, so the two lower numbers add to 15.
accept: two r minus one can never equal two r plus four so the lower numbers must add to fifteen
the equal case is impossible so two r minus one plus two r plus four is fifteen
use the sum case, the indices add to fifteen
equal case possible kaadu, so rendu add cheste fifteen
the two lower numbers add up to n which is fifteen

steps.why: The identity has two cases and a full answer says which one applies. Here the equal case is empty — subtracting gives −1 = 4 — so the sum case is the only source of r.
common_mistakes: Setting 2r − 1 = 2r + 4 and being stuck at −1 = 4 without moving to the sum case.
Adding to 2r instead of to 15 — the lower numbers add to the UPPER number.

steps.label: Solve for r
steps.margin_note: Second mark. 4r + 3 = 15 gives r = 3. Check: ¹⁵C₅ = ¹⁵C₁₀, and 5 + 10 = 15.
steps.memory_tip: The lower numbers add to the UPPER number 15: 4r + 3 = 15, r = 3. Check ¹⁵C₅ = ¹⁵C₁₀.

accept: four r plus three is fifteen so four r is twelve and r is three
four r is twelve so r is three
four r plus three fifteen, r three

steps.why: A single linear equation gives a single r, and putting r = 3 back (¹⁵C₅ = ¹⁵C₁₀) confirms the two lower numbers really add to 15.
common_mistakes: Answering r = 12 by forgetting to divide by 4.
